newsitem.title: UK: Euro oil swaps flat except for firmer gasoline.
newsitem.headline: Euro oil swaps flat except for firmer gasoline.

text.p: European oil swaps were broadly steady on Thursday bar Brent CFDs which tracked a few cents higher.
Gasoline was up by $2-3 while naphtha and fuel held steady.

Dealers said Brent CFDs were only a few cents higher by midday having slipped several cents before lunchtime. June 30-July 4 was pegged at -37 cents against August with July 7-11 at -37/38 cents, although a July 7-11 CFD was done earlier at -35 cents against August.
July 14-18 was hovering unchanged around -35 cents while July 21-25 shed a few cents to -30 cents from -27 cents.

Gasoline swaps gained several dollars with July pegged at $182.50 from $179.00. Dealers said August and September remained flat with July. Dealers said Nigerian demand for material between now and September was helping to support swaps levels.
Gas oil crack spreads were firm with Q4 at $4.45, Q198 at $4.60 and Q298 at $4.05.

Heavy fuel swaps were steady with July hovering around $82.50 and August about $1 into contango. Dealers said physical activity was slow after heavy buying on Wednesday and wet barges went at $83 for prompt fob ARA and $83.75 for July material.
